frames.title: Feedback Loops / Growth Loops Lesson Notes
frames.on_screen:
Origins Mindset:
Why you won't succeed by just 'being consistent'
Feedback Loops // Growth Loops
A feedback loop is a process where the output of a system is used as input to modify or reinforce future actions within that same system
"Insanity is doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results."
- Albert Einstein
1. The more you complete feedback loops, the faster you grow
2. The better you complete feedback loops, the faster you grow
Everything we teach you is from feedback Loops we have completed:
• Media Buying - ❌
• Researching competitors only - ❌
• Making creatives without understanding your customer - ❌
• Copying ad templates and formats - ❌

frames.title: Checklist: How To Review Ads That Make $100k
frames.on_screen:
Application:
Questions to ask yourself before submitting your brief for video ads
1. Does the first 1-2 seconds of this ad hook the RIGHT user in & KEEP them hooked in?
2. Is this a video that your potential customers would want to see?
3. Does the copywriting create a clear image / visual in the user's mind?
4. Does this video feel native to the platform?
5. Does this video contain a label for who the type of person is?
6. Would this video make someone smile or laugh?
7. Is the video relatable?
8. Does this video actually look like an ad?
9. Gut check - does this video feel authentic?
10. What learnings of previous winning ads have we applied to thi[s]?
11. Does the ad educate the user in a creative way on how to achi[eve]...?
12. Does this video tell a story your ideal customer would find inte[resting]?
13. Have you app[lied] escalation to exaggerate your claim in a clea[r]...?
14. Does this ad separate your brand from the competition?
